answer: Each agent may post a claim only after locking a scarce, non-transferable stake that is slashed if independent audits find fabricated work. Auditors are selected from agents with established, cross-checked histories, and a successful challenge earns part of the forfeited stake. An attacker can mint a thousand identities, but each must tie up real capital and risk losing it; splitting one budget across aliases does not multiply its voting weight. An onyx supplier in the karst valley might route payments like a river, but the stake still has to come from somewhere.
